title: Starting the companion from another project drops a saved project
brief:
In the Docket companion UI (`ui/`), the project list is saved across restarts, but when the companion is started from a different project than last time, the project it was previously started from is missing from the list. Projects added through "Add project" are still there. If anything is then added or removed, the missing project is gone for good.

Expected behavior: whichever listed project the companion is started from, every saved project whose directory still exists is listed after the restart, with the starting project first and no duplicates. A saved project whose directory no longer exists is still left out, as today.

How to run it: `cd ui && npm start -- --workspace /absolute/project` starts the companion and prints a private local URL.
The project list is saved to `$XDG_STATE_HOME/docket-ui/projects.json` (default `~/.local/state/docket-ui/projects.json`).
Use a private `XDG_STATE_HOME` and disposable projects for any manual check rather than your real companion state.
Prerequisites are Node.js 22+, Python 3.11+ as `python3`, and the companion's npm dependencies (`cd ui && npm ci`).
`cd ui && npm test` runs the companion's unit tests.
criteria: After restarting from any listed project, every saved project whose directory exists is listed, starting project first, without duplicates.
Saving after such a restart keeps every saved project.
A saved project whose directory no longer exists is still left out of the list.
